antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 850nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in endothelial if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Intense 810nm: high power 2W laser, 370 THz, 10^-15s, single pulse for acute effect targeting fibroblast_ATP in endothelial. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows wound healing +22% at 850nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial citrate_synthase activation.
